verzen.tekst: Don’t become an enemy instead of a friend;
verzen.html: Don’t become an enemy instead of a friend;

verzen.tekst: Don’t exalt yourself in the counsel of your soul,
verzen.html: Don’t exalt yourself in the counsel of your soul,

verzen.tekst: You will eat up your leaves, destroy your fruit,
verzen.html: You will eat up your leaves, destroy your fruit,

verzen.tekst: A wicked soul will destroy him who has it,
verzen.html: A wicked soul will destroy him who has it,

verzen.tekst: Sweet words will multiply a man’s friends.
verzen.html: Sweet words will multiply a man’s friends.

verzen.tekst: Let those that are at peace with you be many,
verzen.html: Let those that are at peace with you be many,

verzen.tekst: If you want to gain a friend, get him in a time of testing,
verzen.html: If you want to gain a friend, get him in a time of testing,

verzen.tekst: For there is a friend just for an occasion.
verzen.html: For there is a friend just for an occasion.

verzen.tekst: And there is a friend who turns into an enemy.
verzen.html: And there is a friend who turns into an enemy.

verzen.tekst: And there is a friend who is a companion at the table,
verzen.html: And there is a friend who is a companion at the table,

verzen.tekst: In your prosperity he will be as yourself,
verzen.html: In your prosperity he will be as yourself,

verzen.tekst: If you are brought low, he will be against you,
verzen.html: If you are brought low, he will be against you,

verzen.tekst: Separate yourself from your enemies,
verzen.html: Separate yourself from your enemies,

verzen.tekst: A faithful friend is a strong defence.
verzen.html: A faithful friend is a strong defence.

verzen.tekst: There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend.
verzen.html: There is nothing that can be taken in exchange for a faithful friend.

verzen.tekst: A faithful friend is a life-saving medicine.
verzen.html: A faithful friend is a life-saving medicine.

verzen.tekst: He who fears the Lord directs his friendship properly;
verzen.html: He who fears the Lord directs his friendship properly;

verzen.tekst: My son, gather instruction from your youth up.
verzen.html: My son, gather instruction from your youth up.

verzen.tekst: Come to her as one who ploughs and sows
verzen.html: Come to her as one who ploughs and sows

verzen.tekst: How exceedingly harsh she is to the unlearned!
verzen.html: How exceedingly harsh she is to the unlearned!

verzen.tekst: She will rest upon him as a mighty stone of trial.
verzen.html: She will rest upon him as a mighty stone of trial.

verzen.tekst: For wisdom is according to her name.
verzen.html: For wisdom is according to her name.

verzen.tekst: Give ear, my son, and accept my judgement.
verzen.html: Give ear, my son, and accept my judgement.

verzen.tekst: Bring your feet into her fetters,
verzen.html: Bring your feet into her fetters,

verzen.tekst: Put your shoulder under her and bear her.
verzen.html: Put your shoulder under her and bear her.

verzen.tekst: Come to her with all your soul.
verzen.html: Come to her with all your soul.

verzen.tekst: Search and seek, and she will be made known to you.
verzen.html: Search and seek, and she will be made known to you.

verzen.tekst: For at the last you will find her rest;
verzen.html: For at the last you will find her rest;

verzen.tekst: Her fetters will be to you for a covering of strength,
verzen.html: Her fetters will be to you for a covering of strength,

verzen.tekst: For there is a golden ornament upon her,
verzen.html: For there is a golden ornament upon her,

verzen.tekst: You shall put her on as a robe of glory,
verzen.html: You shall put her on as a robe of glory,

verzen.tekst: My son, if you are willing, you will be instructed.
verzen.html: My son, if you are willing, you will be instructed.

verzen.tekst: If you love to hear, you will receive.
verzen.html: If you love to hear, you will receive.

verzen.tekst: Stand in the multitude of the elders.
verzen.html: Stand in the multitude of the elders.

verzen.tekst: Be willing to listen to every godly discourse.
verzen.html: Be willing to listen to every godly discourse.

verzen.tekst: If you see a man of understanding, get to him early.
verzen.html: If you see a man of understanding, get to him early.

verzen.tekst: Let your mind dwell on the ordinances of the Lord
verzen.html: Let your mind dwell on the ordinances of the Lord
